info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Campaign Management API
info.description: The Customer Campaign Management API enables businesses to effectively manage their marketing campaigns directed at customers. It provides a streamlined way to access detailed information about ongoing and past campaigns, allowing marketing teams to analyze performance and make informed decisions. This API is ideal for businesses looking to enhance their customer engagement strategies through targeted campaigns. Typical consumers include marketing analysts, campaign managers, and business intelligence tools seeking to retrieve campaign data and metrics.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific customer campaign identified by its unique ID. Use this to get insights into the campaign's performance, targets, and overall effectiveness.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving customer campaign management details for a specific campaign identified by CUST-100045. This body must be formatted as JSON and include all necessary parameters for the request.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the customer campaign details.

FetchCustomerCampaignByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation in customer campaign management, identified by CUST-100045.

FetchCustomerCampaignByIdResponse_200.title: Campaign Management Response

campaignId.description: The unique identifier for the campaign.

targetSegmentId.description: The unique identifier for the target segment of the campaign.

channelMix.description: List of channels used in the campaign.

budget.description: The budget details for the campaign.

startDate.description: The start date of the campaign in ISO format.

endDate.description: The end date of the campaign in ISO format.

controlGroupPercent.description: Percentage of the control group used in the campaign.

contactFrequencyCap.description: The maximum number of contacts allowed per user in the campaign.

recordStatus.description: The status of the campaign record.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the campaign was last updated in ISO format.

metadata.description: Metadata related to the campaign response.

FetchCustomerCampaignByIdResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for the customer campaign management operations.

amount.description: The amount of money allocated for the campaign.

currency.description: The currency in which the budget is specified.

Budget.description: Schema representing the budget of the campaign.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: The unique identifier for correlating requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: Date and time when the response was generated in ISO format.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing of the campaign took place.

Metadata.description: Schema containing metadata related to the campaign response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: The unique identifier for the endpoint that was called. This value helps trace the specific API endpoint in the logs.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that handled the request. This information can be used for monitoring and debugging purposes.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes HTTP Bearer authentication. Clients must include a valid JWT (JSON Web Token) in the Authorization header to access secure endpoints.
